skillCode: var piece = context.rulePiece; if (!piece || piece.currentHp <= 0 || !context.piece || context.piece.instanceId !== piece.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '' }; var tag = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(item) { return item.type === 'venom-corrosion-immobile'; }); if (!tag) { removeRuleById(piece.instanceId, 'rule-venom-corrosion-immobile'); return { success: false, message: '' }; } return { success: true, blocked: true, message: piece.name + '受到腐蚀，本回合无法移动' };
